title: Chapter 214
text:
Out of the three random talents, the most practical one was probably [Frost Resistance]. However, in terms of usage, Han Xiao felt that [Call of the Wild] had a wider range of uses.

Beast-Type monsters were a very large branch of monsters. In the entire galaxy, other than planets that were highly modified or barren, there were more or less beasts on other planets. Beasts were a very important part of the food chain. All kinds of beasts lived on land and in the ocean. Some strong races even lived directly in the universe. The scary radiation, particle streams, psionic dust, and psychic currents could not hurt them. These kinds of races were bosses that would only appear many versions later.

As for [Duplicate Chant], it was a Mage talent. Casting and chanting were magic skills, so it was useless for a Mechanic like him. The double casting effect would not be applied to skills other than magic. If it was not randomly given, Han Xiao would not have come into contact with talents of other elements.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao finally chose [Call of the Wild]. Although his Charisma was a little low, this talent was quite useful.

Blue Star in Version 2.0 was the world of monsters. Han Xiao had a feeling that [Call of the Wild] would come in handy.

His plan was to leave Blue Star before Version 1.0 ended. However, he had a guess. The main storyline of Version 2.0 was called [Mutation Disaster]. This was a mutated virus from the universe that caused the mutation of many creatures on many planets. Blue Star was one of them. The antidote was developed by an advanced civilization. Han Xiao thought that he might be able to return with the antidote in the future and end the storyline of Blue Star early.

After the large-scale dissemination of information about the Germinal Organization before the open beta, Han Xiao knew that he could gain a lot of benefits by greatly influencing the main storyline.

This was just a blueprint for the future. Han Xiao still focused on the matter in front of him.

The incident in Overmera had ended, and the final result was quite satisfactory.

Not only did he not lose out, but he also gained a lot of benefits. Although he stayed in Overmera for a few more days and delayed his journey, who would complain about having more side quests? The more side quests there were, the more benefits there were.

After all, the players were there, diligent and conscientious. They did not cry, make a fuss, or commit suicide.

The next morning, Han Xiao left Overmera, and all the higher-ups came to see him off.

The coldness of the north seemed to have seeped into the hearts of the Overmera's higher-ups, and they all wrapped up their animal fur coats tightly.

Black Phantom had become one of them in name, and this outsider had become the strongest combat power in the family. The upper echelons were willing to curry favor with him, and they even gave Han Xiao an off-road vehicle as a means of transportation.

The people of the Xiao Faction were all present. They were courteous and respectful, and they purposely appeared close to Xiao Jin. The people of the Xiao Faction were full of disdain and envy. If they could get Black Phantom's support, they would be willing to do the same. They all lamented that Xiao Jin had stolen the opportunity.

Xiao Jin, on the other hand, was feeling very complicated at this time. He exchanged a glance with Han Xiao and nodded slightly. Only the two of them knew the deal behind the scenes.

Although the result was as he wished, Xiao Jin felt somewhat bitter in his heart.

Han Xiao waved his hand, not bothering to exchange pleasantries with them. He drove the off-road vehicle through the wind and snow, leaving a trail of dust behind him.

"He's finally gone."

The upper echelons of Overmera finally relaxed their tense bodies. They felt like a huge rock had finally been removed from their chest, and even their breathing was much smoother.

Not far away, the players of the Bamboo Rain Guild cheered. Their mission had finally been completed.

"Black Phantom has uncovered the real culprit and caused a huge change to the situation of Overmera. As his helper, you witnessed everything that happened. Additional reward: 15000 EXP."

The EXP from this mission was very generous for the current players, and the Bamboo Rain Guild was very satisfied.

"Oh right, Xuan Xuan, didn't you record Black Phantom's material?" the guild leader, Bamboo Rain Fragrance, asked.

"I already sold it. I sent it to Galaxy Times, and they gave me a reward," Bamboo Rain Xuan Xuan said proudly.

Mecha, the romance of men.

The background of Galaxy had always made many players speculate about the various combat systems. Mechas were a very popular topic, and there were many books about mechas that had countless fans. A large number of players dreamed of the day when they could fight in a mecha. Among the five main classes, only the Mechanic class fit the speculations. However, since the open beta, there had never been an NPC who fought in a mecha.

Han Xiao was the first person to show off a mecha, and he had unintentionally created a new 'first'.

The impact on the players would only appear after the new issue of Galaxy Times was broadcasted, and before that, the local forces reacted first.

When killing Luhn and Vanessa, Han Xiao had used a mecha, and it had been recorded by the people of Overmera. It had been leaked onto the dark web, and it had caused a huge commotion among the various forces.

Everyone could see that the modified Viper was very powerful, and it was a very mature mecha. Black Phantom was a Mechanic, and it was no doubt that he had created it himself. Its level was much higher than the experimental products of some large countries in the military laboratories.

Han Xiao had made a name for himself as an assassin, but now, he had used his Mechanic identity to shock the various forces again. These forces quickly refreshed his profile.

At the same time, there were many forces that were eyeing his mecha.

The Germinal Organization was one of them!

"This is a mature single combat suit. If we can control it, the strength of our soldiers will increase tremendously, and we will have a much higher chance of winning this war."

In the headquarters of Andrea, the leader and Cyberlos were watching the short battle video on the big screen. Cyberlos' eyes were shining with passion.

The leader thought of something else. "The person who used our name to do things in the Louis Research Institution incident was Black Phantom, and it was this mecha."

"Black Phantom also interfered in the evacuation battle in the Southern Continent. He sees us as an enemy."

"Not to be messed with." The leader frowned. "His mecha is very important to us. Unfortunately, we don't have enough combat power in other continents. Plus, his whereabouts are unpredictable, and he is very difficult to deal with. Unless the top executive of the organization makes a move, no one is his match."

The leader did not want to give up Black Phantom's mecha so easily, but his rationality told him that when the war started, he would not have a chance to deal with Black Phantom, unless Black Phantom came to the battlefield.

The chances were slim. The leader shook his head.

…

Two days later, Han Xiao found a Dark Net stronghold in the Northern Continent and accepted the bounty mission for Hidden Demon. After the notification on the interface, he handed over the Hidden Demon.

What was interesting was that the person in charge of the stronghold was very confused.

"Your Excellency Black Phantom, where is the Hidden Demon you were talking about?"

Han Xiao pointed at an empty space under his feet. "Right here."

The person in charge wiped his cold sweat. "I … I can't see."

Han Xiao used more than ten torture methods to prove the existence of the Hidden Demon. After the Hidden Demon was accepted, the bounty mission was completed.

"200,000 EXP and 150,000 Aquamarine Dollars." He earned a lot of money from using the Hidden Demon. Although Han Xiao had a lot of assets, he would not miss any opportunity to earn money. Even the smallest mosquito was still meat.

The highest level player on the level leaderboard had reached level 20 and was stuck on the advancement mission. At this time, Han Xiao also came to the last novice village in the Northern Continent and made it in time for the last wave of EXP.

In this place, Han Xiao realized that he was even more popular, especially the male players. They surrounded him like a sea of women.

"What's the name of your mecha?"

"Are you selling the mecha?"

This was the most common question. Han Xiao glanced at the forum and saw that the Galaxy Times had released a video of him wearing the mecha.

This issue of Galaxy Times was rather dull, but this video became the highlight. The originally sparse comments exploded like a geyser, covering the entire screen. It perfectly explained what it meant to be a sea of people.

"No wonder the players are so excited."

Han Xiao could understand. If he was still a newbie, he would also be envious of the mecha.

The most direct effect was that the players' passion for the Mechanic class had increased again. More people came to this novice village to change their class, which increased his sales.

The official platform would release all kinds of statistics after the open beta. Han Xiao was looking forward to seeing the ratio of players of the five main classes. In his previous life, the ratio of Mechanic class players was in the single digits. Under the influence of this butterfly, the number of players this time would be at least double.

The more Mechanic class players there were, the brighter Han Xiao's future prospects would be.

Beep beep!

His phone suddenly rang.

Han Xiao looked at his phone. It was a message from Hao Tian. He had completed the mission. He was the first player to complete the [New Era — Origin] split mission!

"Not bad, as expected of a god-level player." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He had not left the Northern Continent, but Hao Tian had completed the mission. One had to know that those guys in the Western Continent who had accepted the mission long ago had not completed it yet.
